# Steel Commander Corp

> Steel Commander Corp sells American-made, pre-engineered steel building kits that are engineered to each state's building codes and shipped factory direct across the United States. Buildings serve commercial, industrial, agricultural, residential (steel homes and barndominiums), garage, workshop, hangar, horse barn, recreational and self-storage uses.

- Headquarters: 2200 Corporate Blvd NW Ste 402, Boca Raton, FL 33431, United States
- Additional office: Nashua, New Hampshire
- Phone: 844.722.4766 (844.SCC.IRON)
- Free quote: https://steelcommandercorp.com/contact/
- 3D building designer: https://steelcommandercorp.actbuildingsystems.com/
- BBB rating: A+
- Builder network: partnership with the Metal Building Contractors & Erectors Association (MBCEA)

## What Steel Commander provides

- Complete pre-engineered steel building kits: primary frames, secondary framing (purlins and girts), roof and wall panels, trim and fasteners.
- A detailed engineering plan custom to the customer's property that adheres to the state's specifications, including wind and snow loads.
- Two frame systems:
  - C-channel: the simplest and most economical system. Cold-formed steel, less engineering time and no welding during manufacturing. Best for garages, shops and storage. Large or complex jobs may not qualify.
  - Rigid frame / red iron I-beam: resists bending and shear for heavy snow, wind and collateral loads. Clear-span frames for commercial buildings, hangars, homes and agricultural buildings.
- All structural steel is shop-coated with gray oxide primer.
- Factory-direct delivery, ready to erect.
- Financing with a 60-second pre-qualification that does not affect credit score. Funding can be available as soon as the next day.
- Installer referrals through the MBCEA member directory.

## Building types

- [Commercial steel buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/commercial-steel-buildings-prefab-american-metal-building-kits/): retail, office and light-industrial buildings with storefronts, dock doors and drive-ins.
- [Agricultural steel buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/agriculture-steel-buildings/): machine sheds, hay storage and equipment barns with wide clear spans.
- [Steel garage buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/steel-buildings/garage-steel-buildings/): one-car to multi-bay garages.
- [Steel building homes and barndominiums](https://steelcommandercorp.com/steel-building-homes/): open floor plans with an attached shop.
- [Steel building kits and workshops](https://steelcommandercorp.com/steel-building-kits/): drive-through bays and office lean-tos.
- [Steel warehouse buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/steel-warehouse-buildings/): tall eaves for pallet racking, mezzanines and cranes.
- [Steel aircraft hangars](https://steelcommandercorp.com/metal-hangar-buildings/): clear spans for large hydraulic doors, a pilot lounge and a parts room.
- [Metal horse barns](https://steelcommandercorp.com/metal-horse-barns/): stalls, tack and wash rooms, covered riding arenas.
- [Self-storage building kits](https://steelcommandercorp.com/self-storage-building-kits/): self-storage runs plus RV and boat storage.
- [Recreational steel buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/recreational-steel-buildings/): gyms, indoor courts, community centers and event spaces.
- [Livestock steel buildings](https://steelcommandercorp.com/livestock-steel-buildings/): barns and shelters for cattle and livestock.

## Why steel instead of wood

- Consistency: every steel member meets the same specification; wood varies from tree to tree.
- Cost: fewer trades, parts and materials than traditional stick-built construction.
- Maintenance: steel does not split, rot or warp and resists termites, mold and mildew.
- Insurance: steel is non-combustible and resists fire, wind and pest damage.
- Sustainability: steel is recyclable at the end of a building's life.

## How it works

1. Plan: talk to a steel building expert or use the 3D building designer.
2. Engineer: receive engineering for your property and state code.
3. Fabricate: heavy-duty C-channels or red iron I-beams, shop-primed.
4. Deliver: the American-made kit ships factory direct.

## FAQ

- What is a pre-engineered steel building kit? A complete metal building package designed and fabricated in the factory, then shipped to your site ready to erect.
- Are buildings engineered for my state's codes? Yes. Each engineering plan is custom to the property and adheres to the state's specifications.
- C-channel or rigid frame? C-channel is the most economical system for garages, shops and storage. Rigid frame (I-beam) handles heavier loads and larger clear spans.
- Can I design my building online? Yes, with the Steel Commander 3D building designer.
- Is financing available? Yes, with a 60-second pre-qualification that does not affect credit score.
- Who installs the building? Your own crew, or a builder found through the MBCEA partnership.
- How do I get a quote? Visit https://steelcommandercorp.com/contact/ or call 844.722.4766.
